name: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd

business_overview: Golkunda Diamonds & Jewellery Ltd (BSE: 523676, GOLKUNDIA) manufactures and exports diamond-studded gold jewellery, promoter-run (Dadha family, incorporated 1990). Seeded via untrusted-X triage (@rajuidesai, 2026-09-13, no thesis detail given).

fundamentals_narrative: The Q1 FY27 print is a genuine positive inflection - revenue +22.7% and EBITDA +69.3% YoY, backed by a new Rs 12 Cr Mumbai facility adding 50-60% capacity - on top of a clean balance sheet (net debt just Rs 5.36 Cr, decreasing) and high, stable promoter holding (72.8%). Valuation (P/E ~14x) is reasonable if the growth holds.
